suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific temporal risk. Apply only to occupational/exposure-related pulmonary fibrosis phenotype consistent with the source and subsequent lung cancer; document exposure history. Systematic review focuses occupational pulmonary fibrosis; carcinogenic exposure and smoking are major confounders. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Pulmonary Fibrosis matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Lung Cancer / Tracheal Cancer / Bronchial Cancer with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
